- Platform document numbers: local D01-D12 are the task page's Doc 1-12 in the same order (alphabetical file names follow the release dates), so reasoning "Doc N" equals local Dnn. Lines are text/Dnn.txt lines (original line + 2).
- Family and target: segment-realignment carve-out (match, then exclude), target medium; measured platform result pending. No figure in the bundle states Russia and Belarus sales or the former Africa/Eurasia part of the new segment.
- Dependency plan: D11 composition note (EMEA = Europe + Africa/Eurasia excluding Russia and Belarus + skin health; Russia and Belarus to Asia Pacific) -> D09 FY2025 Africa/Eurasia 1,172 and Asia Pacific 2,814 (old structure) -> D10 FY2025 recast Asia Pacific 3,038 -> Russia and Belarus 224 -> 1,172 - 224 = 948.
- Universe: not applicable (single value). Composition of the new segment per D11 l.85: Europe, Africa/Eurasia excluding Russia and Belarus, skin health.
- Necessity: D11 is the only statement of the realignment's composition (D10 has no notes on it; D12 l.83/117 say only that the structure changed; D04-D06 notes describe the July 2024 change). Without it a solver has no reason to remove Russia and Belarus (1,172 or 1,314). D09 is the only source of full-year 2025 figures under the old structure (D08 has nine months; the fourth quarter is only in D09). D10 is the only source of full-year 2025 recast figures (D11/D12 recast only Q1 and Q2 2025). Quarterly approximations (1H 2025 Russia and Belarus 1,484 - 1,378 = 106 from D12/D07) do not give 224.
- Selected-lever checks: match, then exclude: skipping the Russia and Belarus exclusion gives 1,172 (D09's printed Africa/Eurasia figure); reading the new segment as Europe plus Africa/Eurasia gives 4,276 - 2,962 = 1,314. Both differ from 948. Scatter the pieces: composition in D11, original figures in D09, recast figures in D10.
- Calculation verification: scratchpad recast.py (2026-10-06): A/E route 1,172 - (3,038 - 2,814) = 948; EMEA route 4,276 - 2,962 - (4,045 - 3,679) = 948. Oral, Personal and Home Care totals are 15,769 in both structures, so the two routes agree exactly. Units: dollars in millions as printed.
- Semantic/ID/overview probes: "948" occurs only as unrelated 2023 net income in D03; "224" occurs in no figure; "Russia" occurs only in D11 l.85 and the forward-looking boilerplate ("Ukraine"); the capture overview for Doc 10/11 does not mention the realignment's content.
- Precision/readings: full-year 2025; whole $ millions; no alternative stated figure for any input. "Operations it had previously reported in its Africa/Eurasia segment" covers Russia and Belarus too, but the ask is the part inside Europe, Middle East & Africa, which excludes them.
- Completeness: complete capture (12 of 12 in full, no gap markers); no source gaps.
- Style/set review: one question for the submission; alternates i02-i04 share the realignment hook and are not submitted alongside it.
- Warnings answered: "origin": origin claude is accurate; export takes origin user only; the submission decision is the user's. Pipe-row quotes (D09 l.463-464, D10 l.28) are given as the local text shows them; the platform shows these rows without pipes, so the form's verbatim check may need the passage saved on the page.
sections.question: How much of Colgate's full-year 2025 net sales in its Europe, Middle East & Africa segment came from operations it had previously reported in its Africa/Eurasia segment, in millions of dollars?
sections.reasoning:
Step 1. Doc 11: the realignment effective for the quarter ended March 31, 2026 combined "the Europe and Africa/Eurasia (excluding Russia and Belarus) reportable operating segments and the skin health business" into the new Europe, Middle East & Africa segment, and moved Russia and Belarus from Africa/Eurasia into Asia Pacific. So the part of the new segment that came from Africa/Eurasia is Africa/Eurasia without Russia and Belarus, and the recast Asia Pacific figure exceeds the original one by Russia and Belarus.

Step 2. Doc 9: under the old structure, full-year 2025 net sales were 1,172 for Africa/Eurasia and 2,814 for Asia Pacific (dollars in millions).

Step 3. Doc 10: the recast full-year 2025 net sales for Asia Pacific were 3,038.

Step 4. Doc 9 and Doc 10: Russia and Belarus net sales = 3,038 - 2,814 = 224.

Step 5. Doc 9 and Doc 10: Europe, Middle East & Africa net sales from former Africa/Eurasia operations = 1,172 - 224 = 948.

Decoy: Doc 9's Africa/Eurasia total of 1,172 still includes Russia and Belarus, which went to Asia Pacific rather than to the new segment.
